title: Practice 7: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Бокс не похож на ___ (остальной) виды спорта.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «виды»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm allergic to cigarette smoke.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «дым»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я бы перевесил зеркало на ___ (противоположный) стену.
exercises.prompt: I would rehang the mirror on the opposite wall.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «стену»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I must replace that fluorescent lamp.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «лампу»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мария хочет ___ (милый) картинку пингвина из пользовательского профиля Тома.
exercises.prompt: Mary wants the nice picture of a penguin from Tom's profile.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «картинку»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «музыку»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В ___ (праздничный) дни нужно доплачивать десять тысяч иен.

exercises.prompt: He got involved in shady business affairs.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «дела»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My boat ran aground on a sandbar.

exercises.q: The Italian text is more oriented to the artistic elements.
exercises.ru: Итальянский текст больше ориентирован на ___ элементы.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «элементы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Катрин хотела пойти в ___ (торговый) центр.
